intro: What sets us apart, and the fact behind each claim.

zones.name: A US contact, a Vietnam build team
zones.text: You talk to us in Plano, Texas, in your working day. Our engineers build in Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang, so the work moves on while you sleep.
zones.proof: Offices in the USA and Vietnam

years.name: Engineering depth
years.text: More than 25 years in software engineering, across every layer from embedded systems to enterprise applications.

process.name: A process you can measure
process.text: Agile with the BMAD-METHOD and the V-Model, supported by AI tools. Project management is metric-driven, so you read quality and progress in numbers.

ai.name: AI in how we build
ai.text: An AI-powered agile development platform runs our delivery, and we build AI products of our own for schools.
